method: Focused semantic reading of runtime R2 and integrator R7, followed only by the R7b corrective delta; AST parse only. No integration, main, provider, or independent Lean build.

finding_and_correction.finding: R7 compared BUNDLE_DECL names/modules, but trusted receipt axioms without equality to column four of the pinned audit transcript.
finding_and_correction.correction: R7b parses the logged axioms, enforces the trio directly on that transcript and requires logged_axioms == report before constructing the candidate. Prior R7 remains preserved.

findings: Runtime requires real integer zero build/audit returncodes (False is rejected), all_verified is True, exact integer ladder counts and provenance status.

Each declaration requires its expected defining module and each embedded source is rehashed and compared with formal_files_sha256. Missing names, malformed axiom lists, missing source bytes or wrong source provenance fail.
Runtime explicitly keeps whole_certificate_inhabited=False and does_not_gate_core=True; the open joint contract is returned without being discharged by component counts.

Integrator validates completed bundle membership, source and object byte pins, baseline identity and the full pinned audit transcript after the fix. It preserves existing scientific source bodies and allows only the three enumerated Python function changes.
New flags are derived from compiled public declarations and added to the exact historical ladder, with explicit previous-source provenance for existing declarations.
scope_limits: The integrator has not yet been executed; this is source review, not evidence that candidate_r7 exists or that its whole rite passed.
Parent-reported eleven runtime fixture controls were not rerun in this review. Actual current full compilation and final candidate byte verification remain required.
Reused module records rely on the measured compilation bundle and its provenance; no independent operating-system provenance or proof of a joint certificate is claimed.
